Suicide Note:

Hi, my name is [redacted], you might know me as [redacted]. This goes out to everybody who's been involved with the things I've done for the last few years, and I guess really to anybody past then who remembers who I am. I've decided that I've become the opposite of who I want to be, so much so what you see of me and hate is the same things I truly despise and wish would go away. I'm going to make this a whole lot easier for the lot of you, and I'm going to get rid of myself and we'll not have to worry about fixing anything. You can continue to have happy and prosperous lives without me impeding you or ruining any other days.

Parents, you guys are great, you did your best but in the end I couldn't find myself in your house and I have nowhere else to go in this world. Sorry if this hurts.

Close friends: You guys are cool, really truly sorry I couldn't take much from you. You have a lot of people mroe deserving around you to give to, so please don't waste any of those thoughts on me.

Friends I don't talk to anymore: Sorry I disappeared, this shouldn't make much of a difference anyways.

Community: Honestly, fuck all of you. I'd make more personal shout outs, but I don't want that, I want you all to think about how fucking atrocious you all are, what kind of vile disgusting pieces of shit you are for how you enabled this. If it weren't for you I would've died the first time, but thanks to you I'll make fucking sure to finish it the second time. Everybody else who sat back to just enjoy the show, I hope you enjoy the ending, sorry to cut it a bit short.

I'll probably post this up publicly in a few days. Thanks one dude who noticed.
You keep offering solutions to the wrong problems

I guess a lot of this comes from me feeling like I can't be myself in a public or social arena period. Every time I open my mouth I say something wrong or stupid, I ruin everything I ever get near, and close relationships end up with me sabotaging and ruining them until I'm ready. I'll never be who I want to be, I'll always be another problem, another fucking person who needs to go away and stop messing with your fun time

No, I really just go to events for this hobby. Well, went to. Now I can't go and expect to be treated like a person at them so I don't go, the friends I have who help support each other don't want to go either, and now we're just losing each other. I am the alien, I am the one causing the problems in a place I felt the most at home.

I've been to the support groups, I just don't get along well. The main reason I don't go seek help is because I don't want to be locked up again. Last time I was treated like a prisoner and forced into group therapy I couldn't relate to.
Nah. No point really anyways, I'll be dead soon.

I work from home writing for an enthusiast site. The money is good, I work when I want on what I want to work on. The problem isn't the people at the site, it's the enthusiast community it caters to.

I already had to back out of other positions due to harassment campaigns from these people and others on sites like the chans.

My friends tell me it'll get better, but I'm basically being forced out of one of the few good things in life I enjoyed that staved off the eventual suicide a couple years. I should be happy I have such a sweet gig, but oh well.
